name: Gamal Abdel Nasser
role: President of Egypt (1956-1970) and leader of the 1952 revolution
summary: Nasser led the 1952 Free Officers' coup, abolished the monarchy and the parties, redistributed land and from 1961 nationalized banks and heavy industry under 'Arab socialism', ruling through a single party. In foreign policy he was a leader of Arab unity (the union with Syria), of non-alignment and of opposition to Western imperialism and Israel.
